name: yappr
description: Approve agent tool requests and get turn updates on your phone with yappr.

device.title: Device
device.description: The device that answers approvals. Empty: yappr config --hook-to, or the one device that receives the feed.

timeout.title: Approval wait
timeout.description: How long an approval waits, such as 5m. At most 59m. Empty: yappr config --hook-timeout, or 2m.

events.title: Events
events.description: Events such as permission,stop,pretooluse:Bash:git push*. Empty: yappr config --hook-events, or permission,stop.

feed.title: Feed
feed.description: The local feed name. Empty: default.
